Beyond this class, we also obtain constant-rate certified deletion for primitives built from subspace coset states, such as blind delegation, secure software leasing, functional encryption, and differing-inputs iO, and CCA-PKE. Importantly, our framework does not introduce any additional assumptions beyond those required by the underlying certified deletion primitives.
  Finally, under the hardness of SIS, we show that public verifiability can be incorporated into BB84- and coset-based certified deletion. In combination with our constant-rate constructions, this yields publicly verifiable certified deletion schemes with constant rate.

</details>


### [257] [PoCoFL: POlicy-COmpliant Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03650)
*Dominik Roy George,Varesh Mishra,Aysajan Abidin*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 PoCoFL，一个策略合规的联邦学习框架，将 FL 类型、策略语义与密码学实现解耦，并通过承诺与 NIZK 证明支持客户端贡献合规性及聚合器处理正确性，实例化于四类 FL 场景并验证其可行性与通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习虽以隐私保护为导向，但无法保证客户端提交符合策略的贡献，也无法保证聚合器按规则正确处理已接纳的贡献。现有可验证 FL 系统将验证规则与特定 FL 设置、学习流程和密码学构造绑定，难以跨网络拓扑、参与者角色和聚合语义复用。

Method: PoCoFL 将问题分解为三部分：(i) FL 类型、(ii) 策略语义、(iii) 密码学实现。作者形式化地将客户端与聚合要求建模为策略依赖的关系；客户端使用承诺和非交互式零知识证明（NIZK）证明其贡献合规，聚合器则证明所记录的被接纳贡献集合已按选定聚合策略处理。

Result: 给出四个形式化实例：(i) 普通 FL、(ii) 持续 FL、(iii) 个性化 FL、(iv) 阈值加密 FL。评估了策略执行对普通、个性化和持续 FL 学习目标的影响，并对四种实例均实现了概念验证原型，展示了 PoCoFL 的通用性与实际可行性。

Conclusion: PoCoFL 能够表达复杂策略表示，同时保持网络拓扑无关性，表明策略合规验证可与具体 FL 设置解耦并具备实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a privacy-oriented learning paradigm that enables collaborative model training while keeping training data local to participating clients. However, it does not guarantee that clients submit policy-compliant contributions or that aggregators process admitted contributions correctly. Existing verifiable FL systems tailor validation rules to specific FL settings, learning workflows, and cryptographic constructions, limiting their applicability across network topologies, participant roles, and aggregation semantics. In this paper, we present PoCoFL, a policy-compliant federated learning framework that separates three aspects: (i) FL type, (ii) policy semantics, and (iii) cryptographic realisation. We provide a formalisation that captures client and aggregation requirements as policy-dependent relations. Clients prove compliance of their contributions using commitments and non-interactive zero-knowledge proofs, while aggregators prove that the recorded set of admitted contributions was processed according to the selected aggregation policy. We demonstrate PoCoFL through four formal instantiations: (i) vanilla, (ii) continual, (iii) personalised, and (iv) threshold-encrypted federated learning. We evaluate the effects of policy enforcement on the learning objectives of vanilla, personalised, and continual FL. We further implement proof-of-concept realisations of all four instantiations, demonstrating the versatility and practical feasibility of PoCoFL. Overall, these results show that PoCoFL can capture complex policy representations while remaining network-topology agnostic.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [258] [Conformal Prediction for Time Series with Deep Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02357)
*Junghwan Lee,Jonghyeok Lee,Yao Xie*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了深度序列模型在时间序列共形预测中的应用，通过条件分位数回归、条件分位数函数估计和局部化共形预测三种途径，在适当假设下给出渐近条件覆盖率保证，并在真实数据集上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习时间序列预测发展迅速，对可靠的不确定性量化需求增强。共形预测虽能提供带覆盖率保证的预测区间，但其保证依赖数据可交换性，而时间序列通常违反该假设。尽管RNN、Transformer等深度序列模型常用于时间序列共形预测，但缺乏对其系统性的研究。

Method: 作者通过三种途径系统研究深度序列模型在时间序列共形预测中的应用：(1) 条件分位数回归；(2) 条件分位数函数估计；(3) 局部化共形预测。并针对三种方法在适当假设下进行了理论分析。

Result: 理论分析建立了三种方法在适当假设下的渐近条件覆盖率保证；在真实世界数据集上的综合实验表明，将深度序列模型引入时间序列共形预测是有效的。

Conclusion: 深度序列模型可有效用于时间序列共形预测，三种途径均具渐近条件覆盖保证并经实验验证，为该方向提供了系统性研究框架。

Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning for time series prediction have amplified the need for reliable uncertainty quantification. Conformal prediction has gained attention as a distribution-free framework for constructing prediction intervals with coverage guarantees. However, its coverage guarantees rely on data exchangeability, an assumption generally violated in time series. Active research has focused on developing conformal prediction methods for time series that overcome this limitation. While deep sequence models, such as recurrent neural networks and Transformers, have often been used in conformal prediction for time series, limited work has systematically studied how deep sequence models can be utilized in conformal prediction for time series. In this work, we systematically investigate the use of deep sequence models in conformal prediction for time series through three approaches: conditional quantile regression, conditional quantile function estimation, and localized conformal prediction. We provide a theoretical analysis establishing asymptotic conditional coverage guarantees for all three approaches under suitable assumptions. Through comprehensive experiments on real-world datasets, we demonstrate the effectiveness of leveraging deep sequence models into conformal prediction for time series.

</details>


### [259] [Learning Style, Forgetting Semantics: A Case Study of SFT and RFT on Classification Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02437)
*Haodong Liang,Yanhao Jin,Krishnakumar Balasubramanian,Lifeng Lai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文通过线性-softmax策略的精确分解，解释了为何监督微调比强化微调更易导致遗忘：两者语义更新平行，但SFT会产生风格漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究一个反直觉现象：即使所有教师示范在语义上都正确，监督微调（SFT）仍比强化微调（RFT）导致更多遗忘。作者希望通过可分析的理论模型厘清SFT与RFT在遗忘机制上的本质差异。

Method: 在分类任务上研究该问题，其中同一语义类内的token以不同风格表达相同语义答案，任务共享语义规则但提示分布与教师风格偏好不同。采用可处理的线性-softmax策略，将参数更新精确分解为语义分量与风格分量，并在群体更新下分析两者的动态。

Result: 在共同策略与提示下，SFT与RFT的语义更新平行，但风格动态不同。从无类内风格偏好的策略出发，带精确策略梯度的RFT保持该对称性；而非均匀教师的SFT在非零任务均值下产生离轴风格漂移。据此证明分离性：从共同完美拟合检查点做群体更新时，SFT在有限训练区间内的遗忘存在严格正的下界，而RFT保持零语义误差。任务序列上的仿真支持理论预测。

Conclusion: SFT的遗忘源于其风格漂移，而非语义学习本身的缺陷；RFT因保持风格对称性而避免此类遗忘。该分解为理解微调范式差异提供了理论与实证依据。

Abstract: Why does supervised fine-tuning (SFT) lead to more forgetting than reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT), even when all teacher demonstrations are semantically correct? We study this question on classification tasks where tokens within each semantic class express the same semantic answer in different styles. The tasks share an underlying semantic rule but differ in their prompt distributions and teachers' stylistic preferences. Using a tractable linear-softmax policy, we derive an exact decomposition of the updates into semantic and style components. We show that, at a common policy and prompt, SFT and RFT have parallel semantic updates but differ in their style dynamics. Starting from a policy with no within-class style preference, RFT with exact policy gradients preserves this symmetry, whereas SFT with a nonuniform teacher develops off-axis style drift along a nonzero task mean under population updates. We use this drift to establish a separation under explicit conditions: for population updates from a common perfectly fitted checkpoint, SFT forgetting admits a strictly positive lower bound over a finite training interval, while RFT retains zero semantic error. Simulations over task sequences support these theoretical predictions.

</details>


### [260] [ENCORE: Exact Non-equilibrium COntrol with Replica Exchange for Diffusion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02538)
*Jiahao Yu,Saifuddin Syed,José Miguel Hernández-Lobato,Jiajun He*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 ENCORE，首个精确的并行推理时控制方法，通过存储生成轨迹避免模拟难以处理的时间反演，并证明目标不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理时控制无需重训练即可将预训练生成模型导向目标分布 π0∝G0 p0。现有方法或依赖序贯退火加 SMC（精确但需大量粒子），或使用并行退火加副本交换 RE（现有 RE 修正近似了难以处理的时间反演，因而有偏），缺乏精确的并行控制方法。

Method: EN CORE 让每个副本存储其生成轨迹，使上行移动成为截断操作，从而无需模拟难以处理的时间反演。证明目标不变性，并表明所得动力学为非平衡副本交换，其前向提议即精确时间反演。通过扩散分析在正则条件下研究稳定性，并提供调度与计算预算的调优诊断。

Result: 扩散分析表明：无引导时，序贯与并行控制在时间离散细化下均不稳定；有引导提议时保持稳定，并可用于调优调度与计算预算。在合成目标、生物分子 Boltzmann 采样与图像生成任务上，ENCORE 达到有竞争力的精度与多样性，对采样器扰动鲁棒，且适用于现有 RE 修正无法使用的蒸馏采样器。

Conclusion: EN CORE 是首个精确的并行推理时控制方法，兼顾精确性与实际性能，扩展了并行控制的适用范围。

Abstract: Inference-time control steers a pretrained generative model towards a target distribution without retraining. We study tilted targets $π_0\propto G_0\,p_0$, where $p_0$ is the sampler output distribution and $G_0$ is an evaluable reweighting function. Existing approaches rely on sequential annealing with sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) or parallel annealing with replica exchange (RE). Sequential control is exact but needs large particle populations, whereas no exact parallel control method exists: existing RE corrections approximate an intractable time reversal and are biased. We propose Exact Non-equilibrium COntrol with Replica Exchange (ENCORE), the first exact parallel control method. Each replica stores its generation trajectory, so the upward move is a truncation and the intractable time reversal is never simulated. We prove target invariance and show that the resulting dynamics are those of non-equilibrium replica exchange with the exact time reversal as forward proposal. Under regularity conditions, our diffusion analysis shows that both sequential and parallel control become unstable under refinement of the time discretisation without guidance, whereas guided proposals remain stable and yield diagnostics for tuning the schedule and the computational budget. Across synthetic targets, Boltzmann sampling of biomolecules, and image generation, ENCORE achieves competitive accuracy and diversity, remains robust to sampler perturbations, and applies to distilled samplers where existing RE corrections are unavailable.

</details>


### [261] [High-Dimensional Asymptotics and Dataset Selection for Private Transfer Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02578)
*Filip Kovačević,Edwige Cyffers,Stefano Sarao Mannelli,Marco Mondelli*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究在仅有汇总统计量、存在协变量与模型偏移、且需满足差分隐私约束的条件下，如何决定是否购买或使用外部数据集。作者以多异质源高维回归和加权岭估计为框架，推导出测试误差的确定性等价，刻画样本量、协方差结构、模型偏移、正则化与隐私噪声之间的交互，从而可优化超参数并判断私有外部数据是否有用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实践中，决定是否购买外部数据或参与协作学习，需要评估新增数据能否带来足够的预测增益以覆盖成本。但该决策面临三重困难：只能依赖公开的聚合统计量而非个体级数据；协变量与模型偏移可能引发负迁移，使新增数据反而降低性能；若数据敏感，隐私化注入的噪声可能抵消样本量扩大的收益。因此需要一个理论可处理的基础来指导私有迁移学习中的数据选择。

Method: 将数据集选择问题建模为多异质源的高维回归，采用加权岭估计（weighted ridge estimator）。方法仅使用汇总统计量（summary statistics），并在标签单独或特征与标签联合两种情形下提供 ρ-零集中差分隐私（ρ-zero-concentrated differential privacy）保证。核心技术贡献是推导测试误差的确定性等价（deterministic equivalent），用于捕获样本量、协方差结构、模型偏移、正则化与隐私噪声之间的交互，进而优化权重与岭正则化等超参数，并仅依据总体层面量判断私有外部数据集是否有用。

Result: 获得了测试误差的确定性等价表达式，能够刻画样本量、协方差结构、模型偏移、正则化与隐私噪声之间的相互作用；该理论支持在无需访问原始数据的情况下优化权重和岭正则化等超参数，并据此判定私有外部数据集是否有益。作者在合成数据集和真实数据集上进行了实验验证。

Conclusion: 该工作为私有迁移学习提供了一个理论可处理的基础：仅依赖总体层面量即可完成数据集选择与超参数优化，并给出隐私保证。理论结果与实验共同表明，所提框架能够有效评估私有外部数据在考虑成本、模型偏移与隐私噪声后的实际价值。

Abstract: To commit to buying external data or participate in collaborative learning, one must decide whether the additional data will improve prediction enough to justify the cost. This comes with several challenges: (i) the decision often relies only on aggregated statistics available publicly, rather than individual-level data; (ii) covariate and model shifts can induce negative transfer, so the additional data deteriorates rather than improves performance; (iii) if the data is sensitive, its privatization requires the injection of noise, which can also offset the benefit of a larger sample size. In this paper, we model the problem of dataset selection through high-dimensional regression with multiple heterogeneous sources and a weighted ridge estimator. Our approach uses only summary statistics and it gives privacy guarantees either on labels only or jointly on features and labels, in terms of $ρ$-zero-concentrated differential privacy. The main technical contribution is a deterministic equivalent of the test error, which captures the interactions between sample size, covariance structure, model shift, regularization and privacy noise. Our theory allows to optimize hyperparameters (weights and ridge regularizers) and, more broadly, to decide when private external datasets are useful without accessing the data itself but only relying on population-level quantities. This provides a theoretically tractable foundation for private transfer learning, which we support via experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

</details>


### [262] [Generalization Properties of Score-matching Diffusion Models for Intrinsically Low-dimensional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02663)
*Saptarshi Chakraborty,Quentin Berthet,Peter L. Bartlett*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文研究flow matching模型的统计泛化，推导了在Wasserstein-p距离下的有限样本误差上界，证明其收敛速率依赖数据的内在维度（Wasserstein-p维度）而非环境维度，从而缓解维数灾难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: flow matching虽在经验上取得巨大成功，但其统计泛化保证尚不完善。现有分析往往对估计的速度场施加较强假设，且得到的收敛速率无法反映真实数据（如自然图像、分子几何）普遍存在的内在低维结构。因此作者希望建立更贴合数据内在几何的有限样本泛化理论。

Method: 从P_data中抽取n个独立同分布样本，在适当的网络架构与超参数下训练flow matching模型，并在Wasserstein-p距离（任意p≥1）下度量学习到的生成分布P̂^FM与目标分布P_data之间的误差。分析引入Wasserstein-p维度 d_p^*(P_data) 来刻画目标测度的内在维度，并推导有限样本误差界。

Result: 对于任意 d > d_p^*(P_data)，学习分布满足 W_p(P̂^FM, P_data) ≲ n^{-1/d} + n^{-1/(2p)}(log(1/ξ))^{1/(2p)}，以至少 1-ξ 的概率成立。该收敛指数由内在维度而非环境维度决定，在高维情形下仍具意义。

Conclusion: flow matching能够自然适应数据的内在几何并缓解维数灾难，且在比现有分析更宽松的假设下依然成立，为其在结构化数据分布上的经验成功提供了理论解释。

Abstract: Despite the remarkable empirical success of flow-matching models, their statistical generalization guarantees remain underdeveloped. Existing analyses often impose restrictive assumptions on the estimated velocity field and yield convergence rates that fail to reflect the intrinsic low-dimensional structure common in real data, such as natural images and molecular geometries. In this work, we study the statistical generalization of flow-matching models for learning an unknown distribution $P_{\mathrm{data}}$ from finitely many samples. We derive finite-sample error bounds on the learned generative distribution, measured in the Wasserstein-$p$ distance, for all $p\geq 1$. Specifically, given $n$ i.i.d. samples from $P_{\mathrm{data}}$, we show that, for every $d>d_p^\ast(P_{\mathrm{data}})$ and appropriately chosen network architectures and hyperparameters, the learned distribution $\widehat{P}^{\mathrm{FM}}$ satisfies $ \mathbb{W}_p(\widehat{P}^{\mathrm{FM}},P_{\mathrm{data}}) \lesssim n^{-1/d}+n^{-1/(2p)}\bigl(\log(1/ξ)\bigr)^{1/(2p)}$ with probability at least $1-ξ$, where $d_p^\ast(P_{\mathrm{data}})$ denotes the Wasserstein-$p$ dimension of the target measure. Our results demonstrate that flow matching naturally adapts to the intrinsic geometry of data and mitigates the curse of dimensionality, as the convergence exponent depends on the intrinsic rather than ambient dimension. These guarantees remain meaningful in high-dimensional regimes and provide a theoretical explanation for the empirical success of flow matching on structured data distributions under substantially more relaxed assumptions than those in existing analyses.

</details>


### [263] [Hold-Out Scoring for Efficient Gaussian DAG Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02785)
*Donguk Shin,Byeongguk Kang,Inseol Lee,Gunwoong Park*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: HOST: 用节点级留出评分＋凸回归替代子集搜索的高效高维高斯DAG学习算法，无需已知入度上界，样本复杂度约 d log p 且多项式时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维高斯DAG学习存在统计-计算鸿沟：达到尖锐样本复杂度的方法依赖计算昂贵的子集搜索并且需要事先给定入度上界；而多项式时间方法样本复杂度较差。本文旨在同时实现多项式时间与 d log p 级样本复杂度，并摆脱对入度上界的依赖。

Method: HOST 用节点级的留出评分（hold-out scoring）与凸回归替代子集搜索。核心洞察：恢复正确顺序并不需要顺序评分上一致的小估计误差，只需要对这些误差的单侧控制——因为用留出样本估计评分会在期望上抬高顺序评分，而这一方向恰好不利于那些尚不应被选中的候选变量。得到顺序后，HOST 通过在两节点间的总效应中递归剔除间接效应来恢复父节点集合。

Result: 在适当条件下，HOST 能在多项式时间内以约 d log p 的样本复杂度精确恢复 p 个节点、最大入度为 d 的DAG。实验表明其在图恢复精度上具有竞争力，并展现出良好的运行时间扩展性。

Conclusion: HOST 通过单侧误差控制与留出评分机制，在无需给定入度上界的前提下弥合了高维高斯DAG学习的统计-计算鸿沟，兼顾样本效率与计算效率。

Abstract: High-dimensional Gaussian DAG learning faces a statistical-computational gap: methods with sharp sample complexity rely on computationally expensive subset search and a supplied indegree bound, whereas polynomial-time alternatives have less favorable sample complexity. We introduce HOST, an efficient DAG learning algorithm that replaces subset search with nodewise hold-out scoring and convex regression, without requiring a supplied indegree bound. Our key insight is that recovering a correct ordering does not require uniformly small estimation errors in ordering scores but only one-sided control of those errors. In the ordering step, HOST exploits the fact that score estimation using hold-out samples inflates ordering scores in expectation, which is the favorable direction for candidates that should not yet be selected. Given the ordering, HOST recovers parents by recursively removing indirect effects from total effects between two nodes. Under suitable conditions, HOST exactly recovers a $p$-node DAG of maximum indegree $d$ with sample complexity of order $d\log p$ in polynomial time. Experiments show that HOST achieves competitive graph recovery while exhibiting favorable runtime scaling.

</details>


### [264] [Invariance of Clustering Operations in Causal Effect Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03101)
*Jani Nykänen,Otto Tabell,Santtu Tikka,Juha Karvanen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究因果图变量聚类的可识别性不变性问题，给出一类基于c-components条件的聚类操作，保证聚类前后因果效应的可识别性与不可识别性均保持不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚类变量可缩小因果图规模并简化因果推断，但任意聚类可能改变变量间关键因果关系、导致错误结论；同时，聚类图中因果效应不可识别并不必然意味着原图不可识别，需额外假设，因此需要刻画何种聚类是"可识别性不变"的。

Method: 基于原图的c-components给出条件，构造并刻画一大类满足可识别性不变性（同时保持可识别性与不可识别性）的聚类操作。

Result: 提出了一个广泛的可识别性不变聚类操作类，其成立条件与原图的c-components相关，并在实际场景中展示了该结果的用法。

Conclusion: 在满足特定c-components条件时对因果图变量进行聚类，可在简化图结构的同时不改变因果效应的可识别性结论，为实际应用中的安全聚类提供理论依据。

Abstract: Clustering variables in causal graphs reduces the size of the graph and simplifies causal inference. However, arbitrary clustering can alter crucial causal relations among variables and lead to erroneous conclusions. While the identifiability of a causal effect in the clustered graph implies the identifiability in the original graph under mild conditions, nonidentifiability in clustered graph does not imply nonidentifiability in the original graph without further assumptions. When both identifiability and nonidentifiability are preserved, the clustering operation is called identification invariant. We present a broad class of clustering operations that are identification invariant based on conditions related to the c-components of the original graph. Finally, we demonstrate use of the results in practical settings.

</details>


### [265] [Predictively Oriented Gaussian Process Posteriors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03201)
*Callum Lau,Jeremias Knoblauch,Louis Sharrock*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出面向预测的高斯过程（PrO-GPs），将预测不确定性作为主要推断目标，在模型误设定下提供比标准GP更稳健且校准更好的预测分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准高斯过程需要研究者做多项设计决策（如核函数和观测模型的选择），次优选择会产生误设定的模型，无法刻画真实数据生成过程。因此需要一个对误设定更稳健、以预测不确定性为核心的替代方案。

Method: 提出PrO-GPs框架，将预测不确定性视为主要推断目标。由于非参数模型中PrO后验的直接计算不可行，作者推导出一个约简（reduced）公式以及实用的采样方案以实现高效计算。

Result: 在合成数据与真实数据实验中，相较于标准GP方法，PrO-GPs在模型误设定情形下产生校准更好的预测分布。

Conclusion: PrO-GPs为应对GP模型误设定提供了稳健替代方案，其核心价值在于提升预测分布的校准性，并在实验中验证了有效性。

Abstract: Gaussian Processes (GPs) are a powerful tool for modelling and quantifying uncertainty in functional relationships. However, they require practitioners to make a number of design decisions, such as the choice of the kernel and the observation model. Suboptimal choices can produce misspecified models that do not capture the underlying data generating process. We introduce Predictively Oriented Gaussian Processes (PrO-GPs), which treat predictive uncertainty as the primary inferential target and provide a robust alternative to standard GPs. Although direct computation of a PrO posterior for nonparametric models is intractable, we derive a reduced formulation and practical sampling scheme for efficient computation. Through synthetic and real data experiments, we show that PrO-GPs produce better calibrated predictive distributions under model misspecification compared to standard GP approaches.

</details>


### [266] [SDECast: Probabilistic Weather Forecasting in Continuous Time with Neural SDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03313)
*Maria Marchenko,Martin Andrae,Fredrik Lindsten,Christian A. Naesseth*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出SDECast，一种基于神经随机微分方程（SDE）的连续时间概率天气预报框架，通过扩展SDE Matching在物理空间直接学习随机动力学，训练时无需反复模拟SDE，在模拟地球物理流与全球逐小时预报中均表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习天气预报模型多采用固定时间分辨率下的自回归滚动生成预报。该范式虽对长程预测高效，但在使用更短时间步时会出现严重的误差累积，且未显式编码大气动力学的局部性与时间连续性。

Method: 提出SDECast——面向连续时间概率天气预报的神经SDE框架。其将SDE Matching扩展至物理空间，直接学习随机动力学，无需在训练中重复进行SDE模拟。

Result: 在模拟地球物理流上，SDECast能够恢复有意义的漂移（drift）动力学，并忠实复现潜在的连续时间行为；在全球天气预报任务中展现出可扩展性，可实现逐小时分辨率、最长五天领先时间的有效概率预报。

Conclusion: SDECast通过连续时间随机建模缓解自回归误差累积问题，兼顾概率性与时间连续性，具备从理想化模拟到全球逐小时业务化预报的可扩展潜力。

Abstract: Existing machine learning weather forecasting models typically generate forecasts through autoregressive rollouts at a fixed temporal resolution. While highly efficient for long-range prediction, this formulation can suffer from severe error accumulation when used with shorter time steps and does not explicitly encode the locality and temporal continuity of atmospheric dynamics. To address these limitations, we introduce **SDECast**, a Neural Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) framework for continuous-time probabilistic weather forecasting. SDECast extends SDE Matching to learn stochastic dynamics directly in physical space, without requiring repeated SDE simulation during training. On a simulated geophysical flow, we show that SDECast recovers meaningful drift dynamics and faithfully reproduces the underlying continuous-time behavior. We then demonstrate its scalability to global weather forecasting at hourly resolution, where SDECast produces skillful probabilistic forecasts for lead times of up to five days.

</details>


### [267] [DAWIS: Data Assimilation with Windowed Inverse Sampling via Multitask Interpolants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03314)
*Erik Wikingsson,Martin Andrae,Tomas Landelius,Fredrik Lindsten*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出DAWIS，用多任务随机插值在单一框架内统一滤波、固定滞后平滑与块平滑的数据同化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流/扩散生成式数据同化滤波器条件于固定历史且仅同化最新观测，无法随新观测修正过去状态，导致估计被后期观测所矛盾的历史束缚，误差在运行中累积。

Method: 用覆盖连续状态窗口的多任务随机插值替换状态级先验的单一流时间，为每个状态分配独立流时间；同化循环将窗口反演为逐状态转折点向量，并在观测引导下重生成，转折点控制每个状态被固定、修正或完全生成；同一构造可将预报并入同化循环，省去独立预报模型。

Result: 在具挑战性的非线性系统上，稀疏、含噪及非线性观测条件下，DAWIS优于滤波与平滑基线。

Conclusion: DAWIS以统一框架涵盖滤波、固定滞后平滑与块平滑，能修正过去状态并抑制误差累积，并可融合预报，性能超越现有基线。

Abstract: Flow- and diffusion-based generative models have recently emerged as flexible and highly efficient forecasting models for dynamical systems. When combined with inference-time guidance, they offer a promising route to high-dimensional non-Gaussian data assimilation (DA), the problem of combining forecasts with observations to estimate latent system states. Existing filters, however, condition on a fixed history and assimilate only the most recent observation, leaving them unable to revise past states when new observations arrive. Estimates then stay tethered to a history that later observations may contradict, and errors accumulate over the assimilation run. To this end, we introduce **DAWIS**, a unified DA method covering filtering, fixed-lag smoothing, and block smoothing within a single framework. DAWIS replaces the single flow time of a state-level prior with a multitask stochastic interpolant over a window of consecutive states, assigning a separate flow time to each. An assimilation cycle inverts the window to a vector of per-state turning points and regenerates it under observation guidance, with the turning points controlling how strongly each state is held fixed, revised, or generated from scratch. The same construction can also absorb the forecast into the assimilation cycle, removing the need for a separate forecasting model. Experiments on challenging nonlinear systems show that DAWIS improves on both filtering and smoothing baselines under sparse, noisy, and nonlinear observations. The code for DAWIS is available at https://github.com/Erik-Wikingsson/DAWIS

</details>


### [268] [Iterating Consistency Models: Stability, Error Bounds and Noise Schedules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03414)
*Alessio Spagnoletti,Abdul-Lateef Haji-Ali,Andrés Almansa,Alain Oliviero Durmus,Eric Moulines,Marcelo Pereyra*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文将多步一致性模型（CM）采样建模为“加噪—近似去噪”算子的复合，在显式可验证的稳定性假设下给出非渐近误差界，揭示噪声调度对收敛的双重作用，并提出可实测的实用保障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一致性模型（Consistency Models, CMs）是少步生成高质量样本的主流方法，但增加采样步数对样本质量的影响高度依赖噪声调度（schedule），可能改善也可能退化，现有理论无法充分解释。因此需要建立精度保证并指导CM采样器设计。

Method: 将多步CM采样分解为加噪（noising）与近似去噪（approximate denoising）算子的复合；在显式、可验证的稳定性假设下推导非渐近误差界，将初始化误差的收缩（contraction）与近似误差的累积（accumulation of approximation error）分离；并给出强对数凹与半对数凹目标下的显式常数，以及一个假设（一步精度与稳定性）可在给定训练模型上估计的互补保证。

Result: 误差界为噪声调度赋予不同角色：早期大噪声水平驱动收缩，后期小噪声水平控制残余偏差（residual bias）；作为推论，得到强对数凹与半对数凹目标的显式常数；实验表明界中出现的收缩与近似曲线可被可靠测量，且与预测的函数形式高度吻合。

Conclusion: 该工作为多步一致性模型提供了有意义的收敛理论，并为采样器设计给出了一条实用路径。

Abstract: Consistency models (CMs) have become a leading approach for generating high-quality samples in few steps. However, adding steps can improve or degrade sample quality in ways that are highly sensitive to the schedule and that existing theory does not fully explain. To provide accuracy guarantees and guide CM sampler design, we analyze multistep CM sampling as a composition of noising and approximate denoising operators. Under explicit, verifiable stability assumptions, we derive a non-asymptotic error bound that separates contraction of the initialization error from accumulation of approximation error. The bound assigns distinct roles to the schedule: large early noise levels drive contraction, while small late noise levels control the residual bias. As a corollary, we obtain explicit constants for strongly log-concave and semi-log-concave targets. We further establish a complementary guarantee whose assumptions, one-step accuracy and stability, can be estimated for a given trained model. Experiments show that the contraction and approximation profiles entering our bounds can be reliably measured and closely match the predicted functional forms. Together, these results provide a meaningful convergence theory for multi-step CMs and a practical route to sampler design.

</details>


### [269] [When Is Accuracy Evidence? A Unified Theory of Generalisation, Validation, and Information Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03465)
*JM Gorriz*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文提出γ-CUBV统一指数框架，用累积量包络γ(λ)控制泛化差距的矩生成函数，将K折交叉验证的逐点精度替换为真风险的保守上界，并推广至PAC-Bayes与多源融合等设定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: K折交叉验证常被当作样本外性能证据，但在异质数据下各折既非独立实验，信息量也不相等，point-wise CV精度可能高估统计证据，需要更严谨的风险陈述工具。

Method: 以泛化差距矩生成函数的累积量包络γ(λ)为核心，构建覆盖Hoeffding、Bernstein、依赖感知、PAC-Bayes与异质源融合的风险界族；对K折CV用联合次高斯代理矩阵建模折间依赖，等相关下导出有效折数Keff = K/[1+(K-1)ρ]；并扩展至预测器后验分布与加权多源融合，权重通过最小化未来风险上界而非仅经验误差选取。

Result: 在异质多模态高斯混合上训练线性分类器，比较K折CV与全样本重代入加风险校正，以覆盖率和紧致度评估界。低维小样本下K折划分因单折欠代表少数模态而增大不确定性，校正重代入可保持有效且更紧；样本量增大后该效应消失。

Conclusion: γ-CUBV将观测性能、不确定性、依赖、模型复杂度与置信度分解为显式项，提供从CV分数到风险陈述的统一途径，并为神经影像等异质小样本应用给出原则性验证准则。

Abstract: K-fold cross-validation (CV) is widely used as evidence of out-of-sample performance, although folds are neither independent experiments nor equally informative under heterogeneous data. Cross Upper-Bound Validation (CUBV) replaces point-wise CV accuracy by conservative upper bounds on true risk. Here we generalise CUBV through a single exponential framework in which the moment-generating function of the generalisation gap is controlled by a cumulant envelope gamma(lambda). This yields a family of risk bounds covering Hoeffding-, Bernstein-, dependency-aware, PAC-Bayesian, and heterogeneous source-fusion settings. For K-fold CV, dependence between fold-wise gaps is modelled through a joint sub-Gaussian proxy matrix. Under equicorrelation, this gives an effective number of folds, Keff = K/[1+(K-1)rho], showing that increasing K does not necessarily increase statistical evidence when folds are strongly dependent. The framework is also extended to posterior distributions over predictors and weighted multi-source fusion, where weights are selected by minimising an upper bound on future risk rather than empirical error alone. Experiments with trained linear classifiers on heterogeneous multimodal Gaussian mixtures compare K-fold CV with full-sample resubstitution plus risk correction. Bounds are evaluated by coverage and tightness. In low-dimensional small-sample settings, K-fold partitioning can increase uncertainty because individual folds under-represent minority modes, while corrected resubstitution can remain valid and tighter; this effect disappears as sample size increases. Overall, gamma-CUBV separates observed performance, uncertainty, dependence, model complexity, and confidence into explicit terms, providing a unified route from CV scores to risk statements and a principled validation criterion for heterogeneous small-sample applications such as neuroimaging.

</details>


### [270] [AREX: Affine-Residual Exponential Integrator for Few-Step Sampling in Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03483)
*Shizheng Lin,Soon Hoe Lim,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: AREX 是一种免训练的采样器，面向预训练流匹配（flow matching）模型。它利用目标的均值与协方差捕获采样动力学中可解析处理的部分，将学习到的动力学分解为仿射分量与神经残差，并用显式矩阵值传播子积分仿射部分，仅对残差项做数值积分，从而在少步采样下提升生成保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少步采样方法（如标量指数积分器）只能解析处理各向同性线性动力学，而实际流匹配模型的边际速度场包含更复杂的结构，导致少步采样时保真度下降。作者希望在不重新训练模型的前提下，利用目标的低阶矩（均值与协方差）解析地处理动力学中可处理的部分，从而改善少步采样质量。

Method: 1) 证明矩匹配高斯目标的流速场是边际流速场的 L2 最优仿射近似；2) 基于该结论，将学习到的动力学沿整条采样路径分解为由目标前两阶矩决定的仿射分量与神经残差项；3) AREX 保留仿射分量并用显式矩阵值传播子（matrix-valued propagator）对其进行解析积分；4) 仅对残差项进行数值积分，区别于只解析处理各向同性线性动力学的标量指数积分器。

Result: 在图像生成与文本到图像生成任务上，AREX 在少步采样情形下持续提升样本保真度，且无需对底层模型进行重新训练。

Conclusion: AREX 通过将流匹配采样动力学分解为可解析积分的仿射分量与需数值积分的神经残差，提供了免训练、可显著改善少步采样质量的采样方案，验证了利用目标低阶矩捕获可处理动力学这一思路的有效性。

Abstract: We introduce AREX, a training-free sampler for pretrained flow matching models that uses the target mean and covariance to capture an analytically tractable part of the sampling dynamics. We show that the velocity field of the moment-matched Gaussian target is the $L^2$-optimal affine approximation to the marginal velocity field. This motivates decomposition of the learned dynamics into an affine component over the whole sampling path, determined by the first two target moments, and a neural residual term. AREX keeps the affine component and integrates it using an explicit matrix-valued propagator. In turn, we only require to integrate over the residual term. This differs from scalar exponential integrators, which analytically handle only isotropic linear dynamics. Across image and text-to-image generation tasks, AREX consistently improves sample fidelity in the few-step sampling regime without retraining the underlying model.

</details>


### [271] [Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference for Gaussian Process Latent Variable Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03647)
*Maksym Tretiakov,Sarah Lucie Filipp,Vincent Fortuin,Ruth Misener,Ruby Sedgwick,James Odgers*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将 Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference 应用于高斯过程隐变量模型（GPLVM），使隐空间变分后验条件依赖于诱导点取值，从而突破均值场近似的限制，提升了数据流形重构相关指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多机器学习方法旨在逼近数据所处的低维流形，而理想的方法应能捕捉该流形的认知不确定性。GPLVM 通过高斯过程从隐空间到观测空间的映射来估计流形不确定性，但其不确定性估计效果受限于 GP 诱导点与隐变量之间的均值场变分近似，无法刻画二者间的相关性。

Method: 采用 Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference，将隐空间的变分后验构造为对诱导点取值条件依赖的形式，从而获得比均值场更灵活的变分后验，并保持摊销与随机优化的可扩展性。

Result: 更灵活的变分后验在多项与数据流形上点重构相关的指标上取得改进，表明不确定性估计质量得到提升。

Conclusion: 放松 GP 诱导点与隐变量之间的均值场假设、引入条件依赖的结构化变分后验，是提升 GPLVM 流形学习与认知不确定性估计的有效途径。

Abstract: Many machine learning methods aim to approximate the lower-dimensional manifold on which the data lives. A desirable feature of such methods is that they should capture the epistemic uncertainty of this learned manifold. One model that achieves this is the Gaussian Process Latent Variable Model, in which a Gaussian Process (GP) mapping from the latent space provides an estimate of the uncertainty of the manifold. However, the effectiveness of this uncertainty estimation is limited by the mean-field variational approximation between the GP inducing points and the latent variables. In this work, we apply Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference to allow the variational posterior for the latent space to be conditionally dependent on the value of the inducing points. We demonstrate that this more flexible variational posterior improves several metrics relating to the reconstruction of points on the data manifold.

</details>

### [272] [Bias-Corrected Estimators for Joint Entropy, Conditional Entropy, and Mutual Information in the Discrete Bivariate Case: Theory and an Application to Motor Insurance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02558)
*Amadou Diadie Ba*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文利用一元化简框架，推导了有限支撑离散随机变量的联合熵、条件熵与互信息的插入估计量的显式一阶偏差公式，提出偏差校正估计量并证明其渐近等价性，通过模拟与车险数据验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 插入式（plug-in）熵与互信息估计量在小样本下存在系统性偏差，会影响风险分类等实际应用的可靠性。作者希望给出精确的有限样本偏差表达式，并据此构造更准确的估计量。

Method: 基于作者同系列工作提出的一元化简（univariate reduction）框架，对支撑大小为 r 和 s 的变量对 (X,Y)，推导联合熵、条件熵、互信息插入估计量的一阶偏差解析式，分别为 -(rs-1)/(2n)、-r(s-1)/(2n)、(r-1)(s-1)/(2n)；进而构造偏差校正估计量，并证明其与未校正版本渐近等价（仅相差 O(1/n) 的确定性项），故共享相同渐近分布。通过模拟（含独立性与 Wilks 定理关系的专项研究）及车险组合数据（驾驶员年龄等级 X 与索赔严重程度等级 Y）进行验证。

Result: 得到三个显式一阶偏差公式；证明校正与未校正估计量渐近等价且渐近分布相同；模拟结果支持理论；车险应用中偏差校正在风险分类上带来改进。

Conclusion: 有限样本偏差可通过一元化简框架精确刻画并有效校正，偏差校正虽不改变渐近分布，但在小样本风险分类等任务中提升估计质量，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: This paper studies the finite-sample bias of plug-in estimators for joint entropy, conditional entropy, and mutual information for finitely supported discrete random variables. Using the univariate reduction framework developed in our companion works, we derive explicit first-order bias formulas. For a pair (X,Y) with support sizes r and s, the biases are respectively -(rs-1)/(2n), -r(s-1)/(2n), and (r-1)(s-1)/(2n). We then propose bias-corrected estimators for the three measures and prove that the uncorrected and corrected versions are asymptotically equivalent, differing by a deterministic term of order O(1/n); consequently, they share the same asymptotic distribution. A simulation study validates the theoretical results, including a dedicated independence study and the relationship with Wilks' theorem. An application to a motor insurance portfolio, where X is the driver's age class and Y the claim severity class, illustrates the improvement brought by the bias correction for risk classification.

</details>


### [273] [High-Dimensional Regularization of the Spatial Sign Covariance Matrix for Robust Shape Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02633)
*Jonas Elmerraji,James C. Spall,Mateo Díaz*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 在高维比例渐近框架下，空间符号协方差矩阵估计量（SSCM）在Frobenius风险上渐近优于Tyler's M-estimator（TME），其优势源于隐式正则化，数值实验在中等维度下也支持该结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在系统辨识与数据驱动控制中，协方差估计至关重要。对于重尾的椭圆分布族，形状矩阵是有定义且尺度无关的推广，实践者常用隐式定义的TME（通过不动点迭代计算），而SSCM作为TME的一次迭代更简单，但在固定维渐近统计不一致，长期被认为劣于TME。作者希望重新审视两者在高维下的相对优劣。

Method: 采用随机矩阵理论的二阶工具，在维数与样本量成比例增长的高维比例渐近（proportional asymptotics）设定下，分析SSCM与TME的Frobenius风险，并进行数值实验验证。

Result: 在标准假设下，当维数与样本量成比例增长时，SSCM在Frobenius风险上渐近主导（优于）TME；其优势来自隐式正则化，以有偏为代价降低方差，而偏差随维数增长而消失。数值实验显示，即使在中等维度下结果也符合理论预测。

Conclusion: SSCM在高维比例渐近下并非劣质估计量，反而在Frobenius风险上渐近优于TME，纠正了其因固定维不一致而被低估的传统观点，并揭示了隐式正则化带来的高维优势。

Abstract: Covariance estimation is a key component of many applications in system identification and data-driven control. Although heavy-tailed distributions may lack a covariance matrix to estimate, the shape matrix provides a well-defined, scale-free generalization for the broad family of elliptical distributions. In this setting, practitioners often employ Tyler's M-estimator (TME), which is defined implicitly and is computed using a fixed-point iteration. The spatial sign covariance matrix estimator (SSCM) offers a much simpler alternative: it corresponds to one iteration of TME. Yet, the SSCM has been largely regarded as an inferior estimator due to its statistical inconsistency under fixed-dimensional asymptotics. By contrast, using second-order tools from random matrix theory, we establish that, under standard assumptions, SSCM asymptotically dominates TME in Frobenius risk when dimension and sample size grow proportionally. This advantage arises from implicit regularization, which reduces variance at the cost of a bias that vanishes as the dimension grows. Numerical experiments support the theoretical predictions even at moderate dimensions.

</details>


### [274] [Characterizing Identifiability in Boolean Factor Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02682)
*Mengqi Lin,Gongjun Xu*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究布尔因子模型（含布尔矩阵分解、认知诊断模型等）的图结构可识别性，提出基于Hasse图的方法，将可识别性问题转化为图同构问题，首次给出无需纯节点假设的充要图可识别性条件，并导出等价代数条件与高效SAT验证算法，进而推广至概率布尔因子模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 布尔因子模型应用广泛，但其图结构（潜变量如何影响观测变量）的可识别性难以建立。现有可识别性条件普遍依赖"纯节点"这一强假设，在实际应用中往往不成立，限制了模型的可解释性与适用范围。因此需要一种不依赖纯节点的可识别性理论。

Method: 1）用Hasse图刻画观测变量的分布，将可识别性问题转化为图同构问题；2）据此建立充分且必要的图可识别性条件，不要求纯节点；3）推导等价的代数条件；4）设计基于布尔可满足性（SAT）的高效验证算法；5）将分析推广到概率布尔因子模型。

Result: 获得了无需纯节点假设的充要图可识别性条件及其等价代数刻画；提出可高效实现的SAT验证算法；在概率布尔因子模型中，建立了在无纯节点条件下联合识别图结构与额外模型参数的识别条件。

Conclusion: 该工作去除了纯节点要求，显著扩大了可识别且可解释的布尔因子模型类，提供了新的理论洞见，并为实践者提供了具体、易实现的模型可识别性评估工具。

Abstract: Boolean factor models, including prominent subfamilies such as Boolean matrix decompositions and cognitive diagnosis models, find broad applications ranging from social sciences to engineering. Despite their flexibility, a key challenge lies in establishing the identifiability of their graphical structures, which specify how latent variables influence observed variables. Existing identifiability conditions typically rely on the strong assumption of pure nodes, which may be unrealistic in many applications. We develop a novel approach leveraging the Hasse diagram to represent the distribution of observed variables and transform identifiability into a graph isomorphism challenge. Based on this, we establish {\it sufficient and necessary} graphical identifiability conditions that do not require pure nodes. We further derive equivalent algebraic conditions and develop an efficient Boolean satisfiability (SAT)-based verification algorithm. We extend the analysis to probabilistic Boolean factor models, establishing conditions for jointly identifying the graphical structure and additional model parameters without requiring pure nodes. Our results substantially broaden the class of identifiable and interpretable Boolean factor models by removing the pure-node requirement, yielding new theoretical insights, while also providing practitioners with a concrete and easily implementable tool to assess model identifiability.

</details>


### [275] [Spatial Functional $k$-Nearest-Neighbour Regression under Polynomial Dependence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02921)
*Stéphane Bouka*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 研究可分离Hilbert空间解释变量、在递增正则空间格点上观测的非参数回归，建立函数型k近邻估计量的结构性与渐近集中性质，并给出点态与一致收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当解释变量取值于无穷维Hilbert空间且观测具有空间相依性时，传统函数型非参数回归理论难以同时处理无穷维小球概率与空间相关结构，k近邻估计量的数据驱动随机带宽也带来分析困难。因此需要一套能解耦局部无穷维几何与空间相依性、并刻画不同空间相依强度下收敛行为的统一框架。

Method: 在协变量与误差之间的field-to-field独立性设定下，构建路径确定的"三明治"夹逼框架以控制数据驱动的随机带宽；将局部无穷维小球剖面与邻域指示变量的多项式协方差衰减解耦；结合度量熵与指示函数边界壳层链式方法处理无界次高斯误差过程。

Result: 在短程、临界与长程空间相依三种情形下分别导出点态收敛率，得到一个同时体现协变量空间交互与响应误差记忆的联合惩罚项；对无界次高斯误差过程在紧子集上建立了函数型k近邻估计量的一致相合性；结构化多项式模拟验证了理论速率并展示了空间长程瓶颈的具体机制。

Conclusion: 函数型k近邻回归在空间格点抽样下仍可获得明确的收敛率，其速率由无穷维小球概率与空间协方差衰减共同决定；所提出的确定性夹逼与熵链式方法为空间相依情形下的函数型非参数估计提供了可推广的分析工具。

Abstract: This paper investigates non-parametric regression estimation when the explanatory variable takes values in a separable Hilbert space and observations are sampled over an increasing regular spatial lattice. Under a rigorous field-to-field independence setup between covariates and errors, we explore the structural and asymptotic concentration properties of the functional $k$-nearest-neighbour ($k$-NN) estimator. By establishing a sharp pathwise deterministic sandwiching framework for the data-driven random bandwidth, we successfully decouple the local infinite-dimensional small-ball profile from the polynomial covariance decay of the neighborhood indicators. Pointwise convergence rates are derived across short-range, critical, and long-range spatial regimes, revealing a combined penalty term that reflects both covariate spatial interaction and response error memory. Furthermore, uniform consistency over compact subsets is established for unbounded sub-Gaussian error processes through metric entropy and indicator boundary shell chaining. Structured polynomial simulations confirm our theoretical rates and exemplify the precise mechanics of the spatial long-range bottleneck.

</details>


### [276] [Goodness-of-Fit Testing for Groupwise Spherical Error Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03469)
*Daria Tieplova,Nina Dörnemann,Tim Kutta*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文针对大面板数据中误差协方差的"分组球性"假设，基于随机矩阵理论构建了检验该假设偏离是否具有实践相关性的定量推断工具，涵盖大维数据矩阵与回归面板两类情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大面板数据分析在计量经济学等领域十分重要，而预测与推断方法通常依赖对误差协方差结构的简化假设。其中"分组球性"（组内误差同方差、跨个体不相关）虽在理论上便利，但在大面板中往往过于严格而难以在实践中成立。因此需要量化工具来判断对
这一假设的偏离在实践中是否真的重要。

Method: 作者将分组球性问题转化为对经验协方差矩阵极端特征值的分析，采用随机矩阵理论的最新进展构建检验统计量。方法同时覆盖大维数据矩阵与回归面板两类场景，适用面为横截面维数与样本量成比例（即 n/T → c）的高维渐近框架。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提检验在有限样本下能够准确控制检验水平（size），并具有较好的检验功效（power）。

Conclusion: 本文提出的基于随机矩阵理论的推断工具，为评估分组球性假设在大面板中的实际适用性提供了可行手段，可帮助研究者判断简化协方差假设的偏离是否在实践上重要。

Abstract: The analysis of large data panels is important in econometrics and beyond. Prediction and inference methods for such data typically rely on simplifying model assumptions for the covariance structure of errors. One convenient assumption is what we call groupwise sphericity: that errors are uncorrelated across individuals and have constant variance within certain groups. While theoretically useful, in large panels groupwise sphericity is often too restrictive to apply in practice. We therefore develop new quantitative inference tools to test whether deviations from this model assumption are practically relevant. Our approach covers both large-dimensional data matrices and regression panels, in a regime where the cross-sectional dimension is proportional to the sample size. The theory is based on the analysis of extreme eigenvalues of the empirical covariance matrix and uses recent advances in random matrix theory. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate size control and good power in finite samples.

</details>


### [277] [Bayesian Operator Learning: Posterior Existence and Convergence of Point Estimates for Gaussian Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03666)
*Niklas Reinhardt,Jakob Zech*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 提出无穷维空间非线性算子学习的贝叶斯框架，证明后验存在性、收敛速率与极小极大最优性，并给出Darcy流算子的显式学习速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究可分离Hilbert空间之间算子的恢复问题，即从带高斯白噪声的输入-输出数据对中学习无穷维算子，为算子学习的贝叶斯推断提供理论基础。

Method: 在连续算子空间上定义算子值先验，构造后验并刻画其Radon-Nikodym导数；对高斯先验建立后验均值的代数收敛速率（对应岭正则化核估计），并分析极小极大最优性；应用于Darcy流解算子。

Result: 证明后验作为正则条件分布的存在性及Radon-Nikodym导数刻画；获得后验均值随样本量n的代数收敛速率；在光滑度匹配时，后验均值在超矩形上达到（对数因子内）极小极大最优；给出Darcy流解算子的显式学习速率。

Conclusion: 该工作为无穷维非线性算子学习的贝叶斯方法提供了后验存在性、收敛速率与最优性的完整理论，并验证了其在偏微分方程解算子学习中的适用性。

Abstract: We develop a Bayesian framework for learning nonlinear operators between infinite-dimensional spaces. Given a map $g_0:\mathcal{X}\to\mathcal{Y}$ between separable Hilbert spaces, we study the recovery of $g_0$ from $n\in\mathbb{N}$ noisy input-output pairs $(\boldsymbol{X},\boldsymbol{Z})=(X_i,Z_i)_{i=1}^n$ with $Z_i= g_0 (X_i ) + E_i$. Here the $X_i\in\mathcal{X}$ are randomly drawn 'design' points in a compact subset of $\mathcal X$, and the $E_i$ are assumed to be i.i.d. draws from a Gaussian white noise process indexed by $\mathcal{Y}$. For any 'operator-valued' prior $\mathbb{P}_G$ supported on the space of continuous operators, we show existence of the posterior $\mathbb P_{G|(\boldsymbol{X},\boldsymbol{Z})}$ as a regular conditional distribution, and provide a characterization of its Radon-Nikodym derivative. For Gaussian priors, we establish algebraic (in the sample size $n$) convergence rates for the posterior mean towards the ground truth; this corresponds to a ridge regularized kernel estimator. Moreover, we show that the posterior mean is minimax optimal (up to logarithmic factors) over hyperrectangles when the smoothness of the prior matches that of the ground truth. To illustrate the applicability of our analysis, we derive explicit learning rates for the Darcy flow solution operator.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [278] [Hybrid Machine Learning-Assisted Raman Spectroscopy with Generative Feature Augmentation for Pharmaceutical Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02224)
*Quach Thi Thai Binh,Ton Nu Quynh Trang,Thang B. Phan,Vu Thi Hanh Thu,Nguyen Tuan Hung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HyMLRaman混合框架，结合深度光谱特征提取、生成模型与经典机器学习分类器，用于六种药物残留的拉曼光谱识别；EfficientNet-B3+SVM基线达96.31%准确率，DDPM特征增强在小样本下对KNN有选择性增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物残留的快速可靠识别对公共健康、食品安全及拉曼筛查应用至关重要；同时需解决光谱数据在有限样本条件下的识别性能与泛化问题。

Method: 将拉曼光谱转为光谱图像，用多种深度骨干网络编码，EfficientNet-B3表征最优，输出1536维嵌入；以其训练SVM、KNN、逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、ANN等下游分类器，采用分层10折交叉验证；并在PCA降维的EfficientNet-B3潜空间中引入DDPM生成式特征增强以应对低数据条件。

Result: EfficientNet-B3–SVM取得最佳基线性能，准确率96.31%、宏F1 96.36%，优于独立CNN基线；低数据消融显示DDPM增强收益具选择性，在训练比例降低时对KNN尤为明显，且效果依赖分类器；应用级拉曼药物分析器验证了模型嵌入交互式工作流的可行性。

Conclusion: HyMLRaman为快速拉曼药物筛查提供了一条实用且可解释的技术路线。

Abstract: Rapid and reliable identification of pharmaceutical residues is important for safeguarding public health, ensuring food safety, and enabling practical Raman-based screening. In this study, we propose HyMLRaman, a hybrid Raman spectroscopy framework that combines deep spectral feature extraction, generative models, and classical machine-learning classifiers to identify six pharmaceutical compounds, including amoxicillin, chloramphenicol, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, ibuprofen, and paracetamol. Raman spectra are converted into spectral images and encoded with several deep neural-network backbones, among which EfficientNet-B3 yields the most effective representation. The resulting 1536-dimensional embeddings are then used to train downstream classifiers, including SVM, KNN, logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and ANN, using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. The hybrid EfficientNet-B3--SVM configuration achieves the strongest baseline performance, reaching 96.31% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 96.36%, outperforming the standalone CNN baseline. To address limited-data conditions, a generative model, a DDPM-based feature augmentation, is introduced in a PCA-reduced EfficientNet-B3 latent space. The low-data ablation results show that DDPM augmentation provides selective benefits, particularly for KNN with reduced training fractions, and that its effect remains classifier-dependent. Finally, an application-level Raman Pharmaceutical Analyzer demonstrates the feasibility of embedding the trained model into an interactive Raman analysis workflow. These results suggest that HyMLRaman provides a practical and interpretable route for rapid Raman-based pharmaceutical screening.

</details>


### [279] [The Price of Greenwashing: Algorithmic Verification and Market Discipline using Conformal Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02225)
*Sourav Bose,Taoufik Bouraoui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将SEC财务基本面与EPA设施级温室气体登记数据融合，构建物理排放基线，并借助梯度提升与Mondrian保形预测提出CWCD指标衡量自报排放与算法基线的背离，进而通过横截面领先-滞后计量模型发现排放背离显著负向预测后续Tobin's Q与ROA，证实机构资本会对环境虚假陈述进行定价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业可持续性披露要求不断扩大，但金融体系依赖自报排放数据，导致财务市场面临普遍的"漂绿"风险。现有文献主要依赖主观ESG评级或文本情绪分析，缺乏客观量化实体气候现实的经济计量手段，存在关键研究空白。为化解这一信息不对称，作者希望建立可数学保证的物理排放基线。

Method: 方法上，将美国SEC财务基本面数据与EPA设施级温室气体登记数据融合，构建企业物理排放的算法基线；采用梯度提升（gradient boosting）架构结合Mondrian保形预测（Mondrian Conformal Prediction），将自报数据与该算法基线之间的缺口量化为新的CWCD（Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence）指标；并使用横截面领先-滞后计量设计对这一背离进行检验。

Result: 结果显示，算法排放背离与后续市场估值（Tobin's Q）及运营盈利能力（ROA）之间存在严重且统计显著的负相关关系，呈现出稳健的市场惩戒机制。

Conclusion: 研究提供了反对"市场盲视假说"的确凿证据，证明机构资本会将环境欺骗定价，不仅是伦理失范，更是公司根本性管理不善的领先指标。这些发现为资产管理者和监管者大规模部署算法审计基础设施提供了必要的量化依据。

Abstract: While corporate sustainability mandates are expanding, the systemic reliance on self-reported emissions data exposes financial markets to pervasive greenwashing. Current literature relies heavily on subjective ESG ratings or textual sentiment analysis, leaving a critical econometric gap in objectively quantifying physical climate realities. To resolve this information asymmetry, we fuse U.S. SEC financial fundamentals with facility-level EPA greenhouse gas registries to establish a mathematically guaranteed baseline of physical corporate emissions. Leveraging a gradient boosting architecture and Mondrian Conformal Prediction, we quantify the shortfall between self-reported data and this algorithmic baseline into a novel Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence (CWCD) metric. Evaluating this divergence via a cross-sectional lead-lag econometric design, we uncover a robust mechanism of market discipline: algorithmic emissions divergence exhibits a severe, statistically significant negative relationship with subsequent market valuation (Tobin's Q) and operational profitability (ROA). Providing definitive evidence against the market blindness hypothesis, this study proves that institutional capital actively prices environmental deception not merely as an ethical lapse, but as a leading indicator of fundamental corporate mismanagement. Ultimately, these findings provide the quantitative justification necessary for asset managers and regulators to deploy algorithmic auditing infrastructure at scale.

</details>


### [280] [State-Space Unlearning for Non-Stationary Bias in Land Surface Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02248)
*Anidipta Pal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SSU-LSF，首个面向地球科学 Mamba 类状态空间模型（SSM）的机器遗忘框架，用于消除陆面预测中的非平稳混淆事件影响，在多个基准上实现高混淆削减率且代价远低于重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 Mamba 类结构化状态空间模型的业务化陆面预测系统会将非平稳混淆事件（未记录的灌溉激增、大坝调度变化、传感器重新标定）吸收进状态转移矩阵，在物理成因消失后仍长期隐性偏置 NDVI、LST 和作物物候预测。现有方法缺乏针对地理科学 Mamba SSM 的遗忘机制。

Method: 提出 SSU-LSF：1) 通过闭式矩阵指数梯度，将 EKFac 影响函数专门化到 Mamba 状态矩阵；2) 用谱半径加权肘部阈值定位时间混淆足迹 Φ；3) 在 KL 散度信赖域内执行无 Hessian 的投影梯度上升，并加入空间全变差（TV）正则化。

Result: 在三个异质基准与十一个基线上，SSU-LSF 混淆削减率分别为 0.773（CropHarvest）、0.821（NDVI-LST）、0.859（ERA5）；最坏情况干净域 RMSE 退化仅 4.2%（ERA5）；3–5 个 epoch 收敛，单次遗忘请求 GPU 成本比全量重训练低 8.4 倍。命题 1 证明残余混淆上界随窗口长度 T_c 增长。

Conclusion: SSU-LSF 是面向地理科学 Mamba SSM 的专用机器遗忘框架，能有效定位并消除状态转移矩阵中的时间混淆，兼顾清洁性能保持与计算效率，为陆面预测模型的可持续维护提供可行方案。

Abstract: Operational land surface forecasting systems built on Mamba-family Structured State Space Models absorb non-stationary confounding events (unrecorded irrigation booms, dam-operation shifts, sensor recalibrations) into their state-transition matrices, silently biasing NDVI, LST, and crop phenology predictions long after the physical cause ends. This paper introduces SSU-LSF (State-Space Unlearning for Land Surface Forecasting), the first machine-unlearning framework purpose-built for geoscientific Mamba-based SSMs. We develop EKFac influence functions specialized to the Mamba state matrices via a closed-form matrix-exponential gradient, use spectral-radius-weighted elbow thresholding to localize a temporal confounding footprint $Φ$, and apply Hessian-free projected gradient ascent within a KL-divergence trust region augmented by spatial total-variation (TV) regularization. Proposition 1 establishes that residual confounding is bounded by $\mathcal{O}\big((1-ρ(\bar{A})^{T_c})/((1-ρ(\bar{A}))μ)\big)$, which grows with the window length $T_c$. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks and eleven baselines, SSU-LSF achieves confounding reduction rates of $0.773$ (CropHarvest), $0.821$ (NDVI-LST), and $0.859$ (ERA5), with worst-case clean-domain RMSE degradation of $4.2\%$ on ERA5, converging in 3--5 epochs at $8.4\times$ lower GPU-cost per unlearning request than full retraining. Code: https://github.com/Anidipta/SSU-LSF

</details>


### [281] [Nearest-neighbour baselines for fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra under different assumptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02249)
*Ling Min Serena Khoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本报告系统比较了多种最近邻检索变体在MS/MS谱分子指纹预测中的表现，揭示了不同推理假设对性能的影响，旨在建立更严格的基线以规范评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明，最近邻检索是MS/MS谱预测分子指纹的强基线，且部分变体可匹敌或超越深度学习模型。但"最近邻"实际涵盖一系列推理假设各异的检索方法，这些差异此前未被系统厘清，导致基准不统一、难以衡量真实进展。

Method: 系统性地对比若干最近邻变体，按推理阶段所假设可获得的信息（如是否使用候选库、谱图类型等）进行分类，并考察这些不同假设如何影响预测性能。

Result: 不同最近邻变体因推理假设不同而表现存在差异，说明基线设定对性能对比有实质性影响。

Conclusion: 确立更严格的基线，以实现更严谨的基准评测，并更准确地衡量该领域的进展。这是一篇报告性质的系统性对比研究，而非提出新模型。

Abstract: It has recently been shown that nearest-neighbour retrieval provides a strong baseline for molecular fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra, with several variants matching or outperforming current deep learning models (Khoo and Barzilay, 2026; Liu et al., 2026; Gupta et al., 2026). Importantly, "nearest neighbour" encompasses a family of retrieval methods that differ in the information assumed to be available at inference. In this report, we systematically compare several nearest-neighbour variants and show how these differing assumptions affect performance. Our goal is to establish stricter baselines that enable more rigorous benchmarking and better measure progress in this area.

</details>


### [282] [Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling for Diffusion Draft Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02251)
*Marcello Bullo,Yanxiao Liu,Öykü Sıla Güner,Arpan Mukherjee,Deniz Gündüz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RASS：基于 rank-aware 列表耦合的扩散模型推测采样验证规则


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有树式推测采样方法（如 D-GRS）在每个节点生成 K 个条件独立候选并按生成顺序逐一检验，虽然有效但仅利用了生成顺序这一信息；实际上这些候选本身隐含一个有价值的排序信息，无需额外目标模型评估即可获得，提升验证效率存在空间。

Method: 提出 Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS)。RASS 沿 proposal 与 target 的均值位移对草稿候选排序，然后以最小化「被选中 proposal 分布与 target 分布」间全变差为目标优化各 rank 的采样权重，并从中采样一个 rank；最后将选中的候选与 target 做最大耦合（maximal coupling），辅以残差修正，从而在任意 rank 权重下都保证精确采样。

Result: 在高斯混合目标、FFHQ 无条件像素空间生成、CIFAR-10 条件生成，以及使用 COCO2014 提示的 Stable Diffusion 3.5 潜空间扩散上评估。以「标准采样与推测采样的目标模型评估次数之比」衡量，RASS 在所有评估设置中均优于 D-GRS，在 CIFAR-10 且计算预算匹配时增益约为 20%。

Conclusion: 利用草稿候选隐含的排序信息可在不增加目标模型评估的情况下提升推测采样效率，RASS 通过 rank-aware 列表耦合与残差修正实现了精确采样并取得一致的加速增益。

Abstract: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion generation by verifying inexpensive draft states in parallel while preserving the target law. Recent tree-based methods allocate the parallel compute budget more effectively than single-chain drafts, as demonstrated by Diffusion Greedy Rejection Sampling (D-GRS). D-GRS generates $K$ conditionally independent candidates per node, and sequentially tests them in their generation order. Yet the sampled candidates admit an informative ranking without additional target-model evaluations. To exploit this, we introduce Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS), a verification rule for speculative draft trees based on rank-aware list coupling. RASS orders draft candidates along the proposal-target mean displacement and samples a rank with weights optimized to minimize total variation between the selected-proposal and target laws. Finally, the selected candidate is maximally coupled with the target, with residual correction ensuring exact sampling for any choice of rank weights. We evaluate RASS on a Gaussian-mixture target, unconditional pixel-space generation on FFHQ, conditional generation on CIFAR-10, and latent diffusion with Stable Diffusion 3.5 using COCO2014 prompts. Measured by the ratio of standard to speculative sampling's target-model evaluation counts, RASS improves on D-GRS across the evaluated settings, with gains reaching approximately 20% on CIFAR-10 at matched compute budgets.

</details>


### [283] [Counterfactual Predictions in Scientific Emulators Without Controlled Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02252)
*Dingling Yao,Kahaan Gandhi,Valentin Duruisseaux,Boris Bonev,Francesco Locatello,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReRoute：结合事实数据与部分机制知识，将预训练主干被查询输入固定为参考值并通过已知机制通路重新引入其变化，从而在无需受控干预数据的情况下实现定向科学what-if（反事实）预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学问题常需推断未观测情形（若条件/干预/历史不同会怎样）。模型在观测数据上准确，但当相关输入被独立变动时，在what-if查询上失效。常见补救是加入受控模拟数据来显式解耦因子，但需要模拟器、计算昂贵，并继承模拟器假设。

Method: ReRoute框架：将预训练主干中待查询输入固定为参考值，通过已知机制通路重新引入其变化，并在原始事实数据上微调，下游效应交由学习到的动力学处理；无需受控干预数据用于适应。给出显式结构假设下的因果识别结果，核心论证在Lean中机器验证。

Result: 在可获精确响应的受控平流-扩散系统中实现高精度反事实预测；在最先进气候模拟中，对留出的耦合气候干预，在严重CO2分布偏移下将总体气候误差降低18.2–31.8%，同时保持标准条件下的技能，成本仅为在额外受控模拟上重训练的一小部分（且未计入生成此类数据的巨大开销）；在由历史ERA5再分析训练的模拟器上（无反事实参考），在固定CO2反事实下保留了显著更多由观测边界条件暗示的地表增暖。

Conclusion: ReRoute提供一种无需受控干预数据、结合事实数据与部分机制知识的定向what-if预测框架，具备因果识别保障，并在受控系统与气候模拟任务中验证有效性与低成本优势。

Abstract: Many scientific questions require reasoning about what was never observed: What if the conditions, interventions, or history had been different? Models can predict accurately on observed data yet fail on such what-if queries when correlated inputs are varied independently. A common remedy is to add controlled simulation data in which these factors are explicitly disentangled, but this requires access to a simulator, can be computationally expensive, and inherits the simulator's modeling assumptions. We introduce ReRoute, a framework for targeted scientific what-if prediction that combines factual data with partial mechanistic knowledge, without requiring controlled intervention data for adaptation. ReRoute fixes the queried input of a pretrained backbone to a reference value, reintroduces its variation through a known mechanistic pathway, and fine-tunes on the original factual data, while leaving downstream effects to the learned dynamics. We provide a causal identification result for this construction under explicit structural assumptions, with the core argument machine-checked in Lean. After showing that ReRoute achieves highly accurate counterfactual predictions in a controlled advection-diffusion system where exact responses are available, we turn to state-of-the-art climate emulation. On held-out coupled-climate interventions, ReRoute reduces aggregate climate error by 18.2-31.8% under severe CO$_2$ distribution shifts while preserving skill under standard conditions, at a small fraction of the cost of retraining on additional controlled simulations, without even accounting for the substantial expense of generating such data. Finally, on an emulator trained from historical ERA5 reanalysis, where no counterfactual reference exists, ReRoute preserves substantially more of the surface warming implied by the observed boundary conditions under a fixed-CO$_2$ counterfactual.

</details>


### [284] [TRACE: A Reproducible Benchmark for Electricity Price Forecasting with Official Operational Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02256)
*Xinyi Yi,Moy Yuan,Ioannis Lestas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TRACE：一个可复现的电力价格预测基准，将预测时点可得的官方运营文本与价格配对，避免信息泄漏，并验证文本对预测（尤其上尾风险）的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电力价格预测（EPF）基准主要关注数值输入，未充分评估预测时点可得的文本语境对预测的价值；引入文本时还存在截止时点后信息泄漏的风险。

Method: 构建 TRACE 基准，包含 7,300 个 zone–day 实例，将美国某主要市场五个区域的电价与预测截止时点可得的官方运营文本配对；在每个截止时点重建官方运营文本以避免截止后信息泄漏；从语义对齐和预测价值两方面评估，并进行跨天文本错配的受控消融实验。

Result: 语义评估与真实价格的中心走势及两侧尾部风险一致，上尾价格风险最为稳定；预测价值体现为时间序列基础模型上尾 pinball 损失中位数降低 7.4%；跨天文本错配消融使增益反转，低于无文本基线。

Conclusion: TRACE 提供了无泄漏、可复现的评估框架，表明预测时点文本对电力价格预测（尤其上尾风险）具有明确价值，且该价值依赖于文本与目标日期的时间对齐。

Abstract: Electricity price forecasting (EPF) supports scheduling, bidding, and risk management in electricity markets, yet existing benchmarks focus mainly on numerical inputs, leaving the forecasting value of forecast-time textual context insufficiently evaluated. We introduce TRACE, a reproducible benchmark of 7,300 zone--day instances pairing prices from five zones in a major U.S. market with official operational text available at the forecast cutoff. TRACE reconstructs official operational text at each cutoff, preventing post-cutoff information leakage. We evaluate TRACE for semantic alignment and forecasting value. Semantic assessments align with central movement and both tail risks in ground-truth prices, most consistently for upper-tail price risk. Forecasting value is reflected in a median 7.4\% reduction in upper-tail pinball loss across time-series foundation models. A controlled cross-day text-mismatch ablation reverses the gains, falling below the no-text baseline.

</details>


### [285] [Approximation Property of Dropout Neural Networks: Sobolev Rates and Confidence Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02253)
*Jia-He Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在边以概率 p 独立保留的 ReLU dropout 网络中，单位球 $W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$ 的逼近问题。给出常数深度、规模约 $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}}\log(1/\delta))$ 的网络构造，并以 Sobolev 容量与仿射函数逼近给出下界，在精度指数上实现上下界匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用逼近性仅说明存在性，无法刻画单次随机采样网络所需的规模。本文旨在给出以高概率 $1-\delta$ 成立的、针对单个随机 dropout 网络的显式规模上界与相应下界。

Method: 构造采用常数深度网络，结合有界局部子网络、在成功逼近事件上的局部化，以及多尺度 Taylor 分解。下界方面利用 Sobolev 容量约束存活边数量，并通过固定仿射函数的逼近要求推导输出层代价。

Result: 上界为 $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}}\log(1/\delta))$；下界显示存活边数受限，且固定仿射函数在足够高置信度下需输出层代价约 $((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/\delta)$。当 $p\in(0,1)$ 固定、$\delta<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$ 时，固定或对数深度预算下精度指数上下界匹配；当 $d\leq2n$ 时置信度项也可匹配至精度的对数因子。下界还推广至 $W^{n,r}$ 目标与 $L^s$ 误差。

Conclusion: 结果刻画了 dropout 网络高概率单样本逼近的规模需求，并在一定条件下达到精度与置信度指数的近最优匹配；最优保留概率依赖及对数因子仍为开放问题。

Abstract: The universal approximation property of dropout neural networks does not by itself describe the network size required for an accurate random realization. In this work, we study approximation of the unit ball of $W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$ by ReLU networks whose edges are retained independently with probability $p$. The approximation error is measured uniformly over the input domain, and the guarantee holds with probability at least $1-δ$ for a single sampled network. We construct networks of constant depth and size $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}} \log(1/δ))$. The construction combines bounded local subnetworks, localization on a successful approximation event, and a multiscale Taylor decomposition. Conversely, Sobolev capacity imposes a lower bound on the number of surviving edges, while approximation of a fixed affine function requires an output-layer cost of order $((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ)$ at sufficiently high confidence. For fixed $p\in(0,1)$ and $δ<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$, the upper and lower bounds match in the accuracy exponent under a fixed or logarithmic depth budget. When $d\leq2n$, they also match in confidence up to logarithms of accuracy. We extend the lower bounds to $W^{n,r}$ targets with $L^s$ error, and distinguish this extension from the upper bound for $W^{n,\infty}$. The optimal retention dependence and logarithmic factors remain open.

</details>


### [286] [Differential Privacy of Gradient Descent on Perturbed Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02716)
*Austin Watkins,Raman Arora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究目标扰动下"释放梯度下降第N次迭代"的有限计算版本，证明z↦w_N在隐私分析所用有界域上是C¹微分同胚并给出Jacobian最小奇异值下界，从而可直接做变量替换分析；对广义线性模型给出无显式维度因子、有限迭代修正几何衰减的隐私刻画，并在截断参数缓增时回收精确极小值证书；同时给出期望超额经验风险的界并可迁移至总体风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标扰动通常释放精确的扰动极小值点，但实际算法只能得到有限次迭代输出，因此需要理解"有限迭代"与"精确极小值"在隐私与效用上的差异。本文动机是填补这一差距：为确定性梯度下降第N次迭代的释放提供严格的隐私分析工具，避免依赖精确极小值的理想化假设。

Method: 1) 对目标 w↦F(w;S)+⟨z,w⟩（z~N(0,σ²I_d)，仅采样一次）做确定性梯度下降，释放第N次迭代w_N。2) 在强凸、光滑且Hessian Lipschitz条件下，证明z↦w_N在隐私论证所用的有界域上是C¹微分同胚，并给出其Jacobian最小奇异值的定量下界。3) 基于该微分同胚性对有限迭代做直接的变量替换分析。4) 对广义线性模型推导隐私刻画（privacy-profile bound），并令自由截断参数随N缓慢增长以取极限。

Result: 在迭代条件成立时，广义线性模型的隐私刻画中不含显式的环境维度因子，且有限迭代修正项随N几何衰减；当截断参数随N缓增时，极限下可回收精确极小值的对应证书。效用方面，期望超额经验风险被dσ²/(2μ)加上一个几何衰减的优化项所界定，并可迁移到总体风险，且主导统计项中不额外引入条件数因子。

Conclusion: 通过建立z↦w_N的C¹微分同胚与Jacobian奇异值下界，本文为有限迭代目标扰动提供了可直接变量替换的隐私分析框架，使有限迭代隐私刻画在广义线性模型下达到与精确极小值相同的维度无关结构，同时给出可控的效用界，弥合了精确最优与有限计算之间的理论与实际差距。

Abstract: Objective perturbation adds a random linear term to a regularized empirical risk and releases the exact perturbed minimizer. We study the finite computation obtained by releasing the $N$-th iterate of deterministic gradient descent on $w\mapsto F(w;S)+\langle z,w\rangle$, where $z\sim\mathcal N(0,σ^2I_d)$ is drawn once before optimization. For strongly convex and smooth objectives with Lipschitz Hessian, we prove an explicit condition under which the map $z\mapsto w_N$ is a $C^1$-diffeomorphism on the bounded domains used in the privacy argument, with a quantitative lower bound on the smallest singular value of its Jacobian. This permits a direct change-of-variables analysis of the finite iterate. For generalized linear models, the resulting privacy-profile bound has no explicit ambient-dimension factor once the iteration condition holds, and its finite-iteration correction decreases geometrically. By letting the free truncation parameter grow slowly with $N$, we recover the corresponding exact-minimizer certificate in the limit. We also bound the expected excess empirical risk by $dσ^2/(2μ)$ plus a geometrically decreasing optimization term, and transfer the result to population risk without an additional multiplicative condition-number factor in the leading statistical terms.

</details>


### [287] [Overcoming Challenges of Interpretive Structural Modeling with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02254)
*Everett Rush,David J. Icove,Ari Kim,Byung H. Park,Michael A. Langston*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将大语言模型（LLM）作为"不完美专家"引入解释结构模型（ISM），探索LLM-ISM集成方法，并比较四种因果图发现策略，发现按行（rowwise）与全图（full graph）方法效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ISM依赖与领域专家反复交互直至达成共识，过程繁琐、耗费人力，且最关键的是难以扩展到包含数百个变量的研究规模。现有LLM因果图发现工作为将其用作"不完美专家"提供了借鉴，因此有必要探索LLM辅助的ISM建模流程以突破可扩展性瓶颈。

Method: 构建LLM-ISM集成框架，用LLM替代人工专家完成因果图发现；对比评估四种图发现方法论：成对（pairwise）、k维（k-wise）、按行（rowwise）与全图（full graph）发现方法。

Result: 按行（rowwise）方法与全图（full graph）方法表现最佳：rowwise取得SHD=160、F1-score=0.77；full graph取得SHD=135、F1-score=0.73。结合SHD与F1分数可见，全图方法在结构距离上更优，而按行方法在边预测准确度上更优。

Conclusion: LLM-ISM集成方法可行，LLM可作为不完美专家驱动ISM的因果图发现，从而缓解传统ISM对专家反复交互的依赖并提升其可扩展性；其中按行和全图发现策略是实践中应优先采用的方法。

Abstract: Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) is a well-known process for multi-criteria decision making. The success of ISM over other methodologies is its ability to model causal relationships, the binary scale of factors, and resulting hierarchical representation. Traditionally, the modeling process is performed by repeated interactions with subject matter experts until consensus is reached. This process is tedious, labor-intense, and most importantly limits the ability of ISM to scale to studies with hundreds of variables. Drawing on existing work of causal graph discovery with large language models (LLM) as imperfect experts, this work explores an integrated LLM-ISM approach for ISM. Pairwise, k-wise, rowwise, and full graph discovery methodologies are compared and evaluated. It is shown that causal graph discovery methods for ISM perform best using rowwise (SHD=160, F1-score=0.77) and full graph methods (SHD=135, F1-score=0.73).

</details>


### [288] [Nearly Optimal Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with 1-Bit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02771)
*Khang Luong,Dinh Thai Son,Hoang Ta,Hung The Tran,Tuan Quang Dam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究严格 1-bit 反馈下的固定置信度最优臂识别问题，提出基于随机阈值查询与截断尾积分恒等式的时间一致 1-bit 均值估计原语，并将其嵌入候选-挑战者算法，分别给出固定截断与分阶段自适应截断两种方法，后者实现间隙自适应样本复杂度，并证明与之匹配的 K 臂最坏情形信息论下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在严格 1-bit 反馈约束下，学习者每轮仅获得一个比特，表示采样奖励是否落在所选查询集中。此设定下无法直接进行经验均值估计，且必须引入截断（clipping）。作者关注分布无关、有限方差的臂级定位场景，希望刻画该反馈限制对最优臂识别所带来的内在代价。

Method: 1) 构建基于随机化阈值查询和截断尾积分恒等式的时间一致 1-bit 均值估计原语；2) 将该原语嵌入候选-挑战者式最优臂识别算法；3) 提出固定截断算法，给出简洁的 anytime (ε,δ)-PAC 保证；4) 提出分阶段自适应截断算法，使截断水平与当前分辨率匹配；5) 证明 K 臂最坏情形信息论下界。

Result: 固定截断算法可获得 anytime (ε,δ)-PAC 保证；分阶段自适应截断算法实现间隙自适应样本复杂度，并与下界在主导阶上匹配，仅相差低阶 log log 因子。下界表明，有限方差 1-bit 反馈所导致的对数惩罚是内在的、不可避免的。

Conclusion: 在严格 1-bit 反馈与有限方差设定下，最优臂识别虽无法直接估计经验均值并被迫截断，但通过时间一致的 1-bit 均值估计原语与自适应截断策略，仍可实现间隙自适应的样本复杂度；同时，反馈限制带来的对数惩罚具有本质性。

Abstract: We study fixed-confidence best-arm identification under strict 1-bit feedback constraints. At each round, the learner selects an arm and a query set, and receives only a single bit indicating whether the sampled reward belongs to that set. We consider a distribution-free finite-variance setting with arm-wise localization, where direct empirical mean estimation is no longer available and clipping becomes unavoidable. We first formulate a time-uniform 1-bit mean-estimation primitive based on randomized threshold queries and a clipped tail-integral identity. We then embed this primitive into candidate-challenger best-arm identification algorithms. A fixed-clipping algorithm gives a simple anytime $(ε,δ)$-PAC guarantee, while a phased adaptive-clipping algorithm matches the clipping level to the current resolution and yields a gap-adaptive sample complexity. We also prove a $K$-arm worst-case information-theoretic lower bound showing that the logarithmic penalty caused by finite-variance 1-bit feedback is intrinsic. This bound matches the leading dependence of the phased algorithm up to lower-order $\log\log$ factors.

</details>


### [289] [MACTS-EM: Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02255)
*Ahmad Shahi,Mamehgol Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MACTS-EM 框架，通过多智能体协作与涌现记忆机制提升复杂场景下的时间序列预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法难以应对机制突变、跨域知识迁移和多模态数据融合等复杂现象，需要超越传统架构的新范式。

Method: MACTS-EM 架构整合五部分：(1) 领域专用预测智能体（模式识别、异常检测、因果推断、不确定性量化）；(2) 元认知层用于动态智能体分配；(3) 涌现记忆机制实现跨域模式迁移；(4) 多模态上下文集成；(5) 对抗鲁棒性组件。

Result: 在金融市场、气候模式、能源消耗和流行病传播评估中，多数场景优于现有方法：预测精度提升 8-12%，零样本迁移能力提升 22-27%，机制突变下韧性增强 16-21%，分布偏移后恢复速度加快 15-18%。

Conclusion: 协作式智能体方法为时间序列预测提供了超越传统架构的有前景方向，尤其适用于需要多分辨率时间理解与上下文自适应的复杂现实场景。

Abstract: Time series forecasting remains a critical challenge across numerous domains. Despite significant advancements, existing approaches struggle with complex phenomena such as regime shifts, cross-domain knowledge transfer, and multimodal data integration. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory (MACTS-EM), a novel framework where specialised agents collaborate to achieve superior forecasting performance. The MACTS-EM architecture integrates: (1) domain-specialised forecasting agents for pattern recognition, anomaly detection, causal inference, and uncertainty quantification; (2) a meta-cognitive layer for dynamic agent allocation; (3) an emergent memory mechanism enabling cross-domain pattern transfer; (4) multimodal contextual integration; and (5) adversarial robustness components. Evaluation across financial markets, climate patterns, energy consumption, and pandemic propagation demonstrates that MACTS-EM outperforms existing approaches in most scenarios, with 8-12% improvement in forecasting accuracy, 22-27% better zero-shot transfer capability, 16-21% enhanced resilience during regime shifts, and 15-18% faster recovery after distribution shifts. Our findings suggest that collaborative, agentic approaches to time series forecasting represent a promising direction beyond traditional architectures, particularly for complex real-world scenarios requiring multi-resolution temporal understanding and contextual adaptation.

</details>


### [290] [Muon Learns Facts Better: Understanding the Role of Spectral Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02798)
*Xuheng Li,Qiwei Di,Yuan Cao,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过一个可解析的事实回忆模型，从理论上刻画了Muon优化器（谱梯度流）如何重塑Transformer的特征学习动力学：谱正交化将GF下特征分离的学习时间比从Θ̃(√(S/R))降至Θ̃(1)，并使误差从多项式衰减(1/(T log T))加速为指数衰减(exp(-poly(T)))，且对正交嵌入变换具有等变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon优化器在大规模神经网络训练中表现优异，其核心是对矩阵值更新施加谱正交化，但该变换在特征学习中的机制仍不清楚。作者希望从机理上理解谱正交化如何改变特征学习动力学。

Method: 采用可解析的事实回忆（factual-recall）模型：一个事实将每个"主体-关系"对映射到一个答案，线性Transformer学习恢复该映射所需的主体依赖与关系依赖信息。分别用梯度流(GF)、谱梯度流(Spectral GF)、Sign GF优化，它们分别是梯度下降、Muon、Adam的连续时间极限。用主体与关系依赖组件达到目标精度所需的学习时间来刻画特征分离。

Result: 在S个主体、R个关系下，GF的学习时间比为Θ̃(√(S/R))，而谱GF将其降至Θ̃(1)。固定S和R时，GF下主体与关系依赖误差随时间T以1/(T log T)衰减，谱GF下则以exp(-poly(T))指数衰减。此外，GF与谱GF对token嵌入的正交变换具有等变性，Sign GF则不然：不同的正交嵌入可能产生无特征分离、大特征分离相位、甚至反转的学习顺序。

Conclusion: 这些结果从机理层面揭示了谱正交化如何从根本上重塑特征学习动力学：它能消除主体与关系学习时间的不平衡、显著加速误差收敛，并对嵌入的正交变换保持不变性。

Abstract: The Muon optimizer applies spectral orthogonalization to matrix-valued updates and has shown strong performance in large-scale neural network training, yet the mechanisms of this transformation in feature learning remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate this question through a tractable factual-recall model, where a fact maps each subject-relation pair to an answer, and a linear transformer learns the subject- and relation-dependent information required to recover this mapping. The transformer is optimized with gradient flow (GF), spectral GF, or Sign GF, which are continuous-time limits of gradient descent, Muon, and Adam, respectively. Prior studies (Nichani et al., 2025) have shown that when the number of subjects exceeds the number of relations, GF learns relation-dependent information before subject-dependent information, producing a feature-separation phase during training. We characterize this separation with the learning times when the subject- and relation-dependent components of the prediction reach a target accuracy. With $S$ subjects and $R$ relations, GF has a learning-time ratio of $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{S/R})$, whereas Spectral GF reduces this ratio to $\widetildeΘ(1)$. In addition, for fixed $S$ and $R$, the subject- and relation-dependent errors decay as $1/(T\log T)$ in training time $T$ under GF, but as $\exp(-\mathrm{poly}(T))$ under spectral GF. Finally, we show that GF and spectral GF are equivariant under orthogonal transformations of the token embeddings, whereas Sign GF is not: Different orthonormal embeddings can potentially produce no feature separation, a large feature-separation phase, or even a reversed learning order. These results provide a mechanistic view of how spectral orthogonalization can fundamentally reshape feature-learning dynamics.

</details>


### [291] [Below what training size do deep tabular generators stop beating trivial baselines? A preregistered benchmark on a size ladder of clinical and standard datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03500)
*Shivam Shrivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该预注册基准比较深度表格生成模型与简单基线的性能，覆盖8个公开数据集(200至20000行子采样)及4个原生小样本临床数据集，共2220次运行。结果显示24个(数据集,深度模型)对中23个深度模型未显著超过最佳平凡基线，最佳基线在49个单元格中胜出40个，且"深度模型排名在小样本下不稳定"的预注册假设被证伪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度表格生成模型通常在数万行的数据集上评估，而临床数据集仅数百行与之差异巨大。论文旨在通过规模阶梯基准，确定两种规模区间下模型表现的分歧点，并验证深度模型排名在小样本下是否稳定。

Method: 预注册并运行规模阶梯基准：8个公开数据集按200至20000行子采样，7种生成器(独立边缘分布、高斯copula、SMOTE、无条件SMOTE、CTGAN、TVAE、TabDDPM)，固定20次调参预算与5个评估种子，另加4个原生小样本临床数据集按真实规模运行，共2220次运行。主指标为在合成数据上训练、在真实数据上测试的固定分类器AUROC。

Result: 24个(数据集,深度模型)对中23个在任何训练规模下深度模型均未超过最佳平凡基线超过种子噪声；最佳基线在49个(数据集,规模)单元格中胜出40个。排名稳定性的预注册假设被证伪：5000行以下相邻层级间平均Kendall tau为0.806(高于0.8阈值)，且最小规模下稳定性最高。81%的单元格中前两名方法差距小于种子间变异。原生小样本临床数据集与子采样大数据集的排名仅中等一致(平均tau 0.57至0.64)。

Conclusion: 现有深度表格生成模型在小样本临床规模下相较简单基线无实质优势，且子采样大数据集不能可靠替代原生小数据集。2220个结果文件、预注册及其哈希、可复现所有图表与数值的代码均已公开。

Abstract: Deep tabular generative models are benchmarked on datasets with tens of thousands of rows; clinical datasets have hundreds. We preregistered and ran a size-ladder benchmark to find where the two regimes diverge: 8 public datasets subsampled from 200 to 20,000 training rows, seven generators (independent marginals, Gaussian copula, SMOTE, unconditional SMOTE, CTGAN, TVAE, TabDDPM) with a fixed 20-trial tuning budget and 5 evaluation seeds, plus 4 natively small clinical datasets at true size, for 2,220 committed runs in total. The primary metric is the AUROC of fixed classifiers trained on synthetic and tested on real data. In 23 of 24 (dataset, deep model) pairs no deep model ever beats the best trivial baseline by more than seed noise, at any training size we measured. The best baseline wins 40 of 49 (dataset, size) cells. Our preregistered prediction that the deep models' ranking would be unstable at small sizes is falsified: mean Kendall tau between adjacent rungs below 5,000 rows is 0.806, above our 0.8 threshold, and stability is highest at the smallest sizes rather than lowest. One caveat bounds all of this: in 81% of cells the gap between the top two methods is smaller than the variation between seeds. Finally, method rankings on natively small clinical datasets agree only moderately with rankings on subsampled large ones (mean tau 0.57 to 0.64), which questions whether a subsampled large dataset can stand in for a small one. All 2,220 result files, the preregistration and its hash, and the code that regenerates every figure and number from those files are public.

</details>


### [292] [Parameter-Free Interval-Dynamic Regret under Heavy-Tailed Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02258)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究每轮仅有一个无偏随机次梯度的在线凸优化，在未知有限条件p阶噪声矩（1<p≤2）下，给出对任意长度n区间与比较器路径自适应的最优（至对数因子）遗憾界，并配以匹配的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典在线凸优化遗憾界依赖于已知的梯度上界G、噪声水平σ与p，且通常只对全时域最优。本文希望去除这些先验知识，同时实现对任意区间的自适应：既保持均值梯度项与噪声项各自的指数，又额外支付比较器复杂度，并刻画区间自适应与全时域最优保证之间的内在代价。

Method: 构造一个同时处理均值梯度项与随机噪声项的区间自适应算法：以期望校准（calibration in expectation）控制学习率与观测尺度变化带来的开销；用一般性定理与"可预测可用专家"上的分布进行比较，其相对熵依赖非均匀先验；由该一般性定理导出静态比较与确定性划分两类特例。下界方面采用测度变换（change-of-measure）论证。

Result: 对长度n区间与Λ_I=1+P_I/D的比较器路径，算法（不使用G、σ、p、I、P_I）达到
E[Regret_I(u)]≤min{GDn, C[GD√(n(Λ_I+log²(2T))) + σDn^{1/p}(Λ_I+log²(2T))^{(p-1)/p}]}，
常数通用。区间自适应仅增加比较器复杂度，均值梯度指数1/2与噪声指数1/p保持不变。在给定统计量下区间代价降为1+log(T/n)，包含最优的全时域静态速率；下界表明保持全时域最优保证的算法其对数项具有该噪声幂次（在显式条件下）。

Conclusion: 在线凸优化可在未知G、σ、p的情况下实现区间自适应最优遗憾界；区间自适应的额外开销仅体现在比较器复杂度上，通用定理统一了静态与动态、均匀与非均匀先验的情形，并给出对数项不可避免的下界。

Abstract: We study online convex optimization with one unbiased stochastic subgradient per round and an unknown finite conditional $p$th noise moment, $1<p\le2$. For every fixed interval $I$ of length $n$ and comparator path with $Λ_I=1+P_I/D$, one learner achieves
  \[ E[Regret_I(u)]\le\min(GDn, C[GD\sqrt{n(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))} +σDn^{1/p}(Λ_I+\log^2(2T))^{(p-1)/p}]). \]
  The learner uses none of $G,σ,p,I,P_I$, and the constant is universal. Interval adaptation adds to comparator complexity, preserving the distinct mean-gradient and noise exponents. The analysis controls calibration in expectation and limits the cost of observation-scale changes. Its general theorem compares to distributions over predictably available experts with relative-entropy dependence on a nonuniform prior. A common prior favors long windows and long restart lengths. With the statistics supplied, the interval cost becomes $1+\log(T/n)$, including the optimal full-horizon static rate. A change-of-measure lower bound identifies the noise power of this logarithm for learners retaining a full-horizon optimal guarantee, under explicit conditions. Static comparisons and deterministic partitions follow from the same decisions.

</details>


### [293] [Broken scale symmetries in undercomplete linear autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03640)
*Farhad Pashakhanloo,Jacob A. Zavatone-Veth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究欠完备线性自编码器中SGD的尺度漂移：在PCA解流形上，SGD偏好增大解码器权重，该漂移发生在慢时间尺度且可解析刻画，最终受有限步长稳定性边界限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络损失景观具有多种对称性，梯度流保持这些对称性，但有限步长SGD会打破它们。已有工作记录了SGD打破逐层缩放对称性以平衡梯度噪声或最小化波动的案例，但尚不清楚损失几何本身是否会选择特定的漂移方向。

Method: 以欠完备线性自编码器为具体模型，分析其在PCA解流形上的解几何，考察SGD诱导的尺度漂移方向与时间尺度，并给出可解析处理的有效动力学描述；同时考察漂移受有限步长稳定性边界限制的行为，并用损失Hessian最大特征值等指标度量解的锐度。

Result: 在PCA解流形上，SGD偏好较大的解码器权重，即存在有向的尺度漂移；该漂移发生在慢时间尺度上，具有解析可处理的有效描述；漂移不能无限持续，尺度增大会将动力学推向有限步长稳定性边界；所得解在损失Hessian最大特征值意义下比平衡基线更锐，但不同锐度度量可能朝相反方向变化。

Conclusion: 欠完备自编码器给出了一个具体例证：损失几何能将残余梯度噪声转化为沿功能等价解流形的有向运动，表明SGD打破对称性的方向由解流形的几何性质所选择。
